description: Provision the four Lambdas with AWS CDK v2 (Python) under infra-cdk/: a reusable MockServiceStack (DynamoDB table + Lambda + Function URL + least-privilege IAM) instantiated per service, CfnOutputs for each Function URL and function ARN (Task-4-ready), CDK synth assertion tests, and the scripts/reset-mock-tables.ps1 maintenance script. This covers plan steps 10-14. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001: the CDK bundles the tools-lambdas/ asset and references the <svc>.handler.lambda_handler entrypoints created there. Synth + assertion tests run offline with no AWS creds; deploy/bootstrap are operator actions, not performed here.
steps: READ FIRST: docs/.agents/tasks/task3-lambda-reimpl/context.json and this file, then Decision 4 + the CDK layout section of docs/.agents/tasks/task3-design.md. Confirm FEAT-001 produced tools-lambdas/<svc>/handler.py exposing lambda_handler and the common/ package (the asset the stacks bundle). context.json replaces re-exploration.

Step 10 (scaffold CDK app + venv): replace infra-cdk/.gitkeep with cdk.json ("app": "python app.py"), requirements.txt (aws-cdk-lib>=2.0,<3 and constructs>=10,<11), requirements-dev.txt (pytest), app.py (cdk.App() with env account=<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID> region=us-east-1), mahalo_infra/__init__.py, and README.md documenting cdk bootstrap --profile lava (one-time, re-run after monthly account reset), cdk deploy --all --profile lava (prints the four Function URLs + ARNs), teardown (cdk destroy --all), the env-output->*_URL mapping (base URL carries NO trailing slash), and that scripts/reset-mock-tables.ps1 is the operator reset path. Create infra-cdk/.venv and pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt.

Step 11 (stacks): implement infra-cdk/mahalo_infra/mock_service_stack.py as a reusable Stack parameterized by service name + default token, creating per service: (1) DynamoDB table mahalo-mock-<svc> pk(S) partition + sk(S) sort, BillingMode.PAY_PER_REQUEST, RemovalPolicy.DESTROY; (2) lambda.Function runtime=PYTHON_3_13, handler='<svc>.handler.lambda_handler', code=Code.from_asset('../tools-lambdas', exclude=[the other three service dirs, 'tests', '.venv', '**/__pycache__', 'requirements-dev.txt']), memory_size=256, timeout=Duration.seconds(30), environment TABLE_NAME + MOCK_<SVC>_TOKEN (default matching the agent; CDK deliberately does NOT set GITHUB_MODE so health reads mock); (3) table.grant_read_write_data(fn); (4) fn.add_function_url(auth_type=FunctionUrlAuthType.NONE). Emit CfnOutput for each Function URL (JiraUrl/ConfluenceUrl/GithubUrl/ServiceNowUrl) AND function ARN (JiraArn/.../ServiceNowArn) for Task 4. Wire all four stacks in app.py.

Step 12 (synth tests): infra-cdk/tests/__init__.py + infra-cdk/tests/test_synth.py using aws_cdk.assertions.Template per stack asserting: one AWS::DynamoDB::Table (PAY_PER_REQUEST, pk/sk key schema), one AWS::Lambda::Function (Runtime python3.13, Handler <svc>.handler.lambda_handler, TABLE_NAME env present), one AWS::Lambda::Url (AuthType NONE), and an IAM policy scoped to that single table (least privilege).

Step 13 (reset script): scripts/reset-mock-tables.ps1 (param -Profile lava default) that for each of the four mahalo-mock-* tables BY EXACT NAME deletes the _meta/seeded sentinel and the collection items so the next call re-seeds. Target ONLY the four named tables — no wildcard scans, no DeleteTable/drop. High-blast-radius; guard to exact names; never reachable by the agent.
Step 14 (regression gate): run both suites + a fresh synth together; confirm no file under agent/ or mahalo-dock/ changed and no langchain/langgraph import under tools-lambdas/ or infra-cdk/.
acceptance_criteria: cdk synth --all (infra-cdk/.venv active) produces four CloudFormation templates with no error and no AWS credentials required.

Each stack synthesizes exactly one DynamoDB table (PAY_PER_REQUEST, pk/sk), one python3.13 Lambda whose handler is <svc>.handler.lambda_handler with a TABLE_NAME env var, one Function URL with AuthType NONE, and an IAM policy referencing only that stack's own table (least privilege).
Each stack emits CfnOutputs for both its Function URL and its function ARN (for Task 4 Gateway import).
scripts/reset-mock-tables.ps1 parses without syntax error and references only the four exact table names mahalo-mock-jira/-confluence/-github/-servicenow (no wildcard, no DeleteTable).
The full tools-lambdas suite still passes and no file under agent/ is modified; no langchain/langgraph import under tools-lambdas/ or infra-cdk/.
verification: cd infra-cdk ; & .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt ; & .venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import aws_cdk, constructs; print('cdk OK')" -> prints cdk OK
cd infra-cdk ; .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1 ; cdk synth --all -> four templates, no error (no AWS creds)
cd infra-cdk ; & .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests -q -> all synth assertion tests pass
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Command -Syntax ./scripts/reset-mock-tables.ps1" -> parses with no syntax error

From repo root: & "tools-lambdas/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" -m pytest tools-lambdas/tests -q -> still green ; git status shows no changes under agent/ ; grep for langchain/langgraph under tools-lambdas and infra-cdk returns nothing
findings:
FEAT-002 complete; plan steps 10-14 done. infra-cdk/ CDK v2 Python app scaffolded with its own .venv (gitignored), aws-cdk-lib>=2,<3 + constructs>=10,<11 installed. Verification (all green, offline, no AWS creds): `& infra-cdk/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest infra-cdk/tests -q` -> 20 passed; `cdk synth` (venv active) -> four templates in cdk.out with EXIT 0; reset script parses (Get-Command -Syntax OK); tools-lambdas suite still 68 passed. No agent/ changes; no langchain/langgraph under tools-lambdas or infra-cdk. Nothing committed.

Integration notes for later steps (esp. Task 4 Gateway):
- app.py instantiates ONE reusable MockServiceStack per service. Stack IDs (CloudFormation stack names): MahaloMockJiraStack, MahaloMockConfluenceStack, MahaloMockGithubStack, MahaloMockServicenowStack (service.capitalize(), so 'Servicenow' not 'ServiceNow'). Account <AWS_ACCOUNT_ID> / region us-east-1 hardcoded in app.py via cdk.Environment.
- Each stack emits exactly TWO CfnOutputs (output logical IDs use the design's casing, independent of the stack name): Jira -> JiraUrl/JiraArn; Confluence -> ConfluenceUrl/ConfluenceArn; Github -> GithubUrl/GithubArn; ServiceNow -> ServiceNowUrl/ServiceNowArn. Task 4 imports the *Arn outputs for the Gateway; the *Url outputs map to the agent's JIRA_URL/CONFLUENCE_URL/GITHUB_URL/SERVICENOW_URL env vars. A Function URL value ends with a trailing '/'; strip it so the agent's base URL carries NO trailing slash (agent builds '<base>/projects' etc.).
- Per-function Lambda: runtime python3.13, handler '<svc>.handler.lambda_handler', memory 256MB, timeout 30s, Code.from_asset('../tools-lambdas', exclude=[other three service dirs, 'tests', '.venv', '**/__pycache__', 'requirements-dev.txt', '.gitkeep']). Env vars set: TABLE_NAME=mahalo-mock-<svc> and MOCK_<SVC>_TOKEN (defaults mock-<svc>-token-12345). GITHUB_MODE deliberately NOT set (handler defaults to mock, /health reports {"mode":"mock"}).
- DynamoDB table per stack: name mahalo-mock-<svc>, pk(S,HASH)+sk(S,RANGE), BillingMode PAY_PER_REQUEST, RemovalPolicy.DESTROY. table.grant_read_write_data(fn) -> single inline IAM policy scoped to that one table (least privilege; verified by test_iam_policy_scoped_to_single_table).
- Function URL auth_type=NONE (Lambdas enforce X-API-Token themselves). CDK adds the InvokeFunctionUrl + public Permission automatically.
- CLI NOTE: installed aws-cdk 2.1145.0 does NOT accept `cdk synth --all` (it warns 'Unknown option --all' and ignores the flag) but then synthesizes ALL stacks anyway when no stack id is given (exit 0, all four templates written). To synth a single stack use `cdk synth <StackId>`. Deploy with `cdk deploy --all --profile lava` (operator; requires one-time `cdk bootstrap --profile lava`, not run here).
- infra-cdk/.gitkeep was deleted (replaced by the real app). scripts/reset-mock-tables.ps1 is the operator data-reset path: clears items (incl. the _meta/seeded sentinel) from the four EXACT table names so they re-seed on next call; no wildcards, no DeleteTable, guarded by SupportsShouldProcess High ConfirmImpact; never reachable by the agent.
